body:
Generated maps currently expose a composite start score but give little per-player detail about contested supply or expansion ground. This adds final-map measurements for each colony: reachable and fertile/buildable ground, nearest-territory shares, rival access, and separate stock and first/tied access for all eight resource types. Fixed 12-, 24-, and 48-step views let studies compare each position close to home and farther out. The JSON report includes per-player values and spreads across players; the in-game start-quality view shows separate wheat and wood stock. The existing fairness factors, formula, and candidate selection are unchanged.

These measurements are plausible position indicators, not tested predictors of wins. The screen adds one stock line; gameplay, save format, replay acceptance, and network rules are unchanged. The extra final-map analysis could affect generation time; no before/after timing claim is made here.

Validation:
- Optimized client and map-report harness built on macOS.
- `python3 test/test_map_report.py build/src/glob2 build/src/MapReportHarness` passed. It checks the schema, 12/24/48-step consistency, territory/rival counts against the separate walking analysis, fairness formulas, unchanged serialized state/RNG, old saves, and generated/reloaded JSON. CI uploads the generated map-report artifacts.
- `build/src/CustomGameSetupHarness artifacts/custom-game/metrics` passed and captured the 640×480 start-quality screen below.
- `python3 data/check_translations.py --strict` and `python3 test/test_translations.py` passed; the added screen line reuses existing localized labels.

![Start-quality view with separate wheat and wood stock](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Globulation2/glob2/feat/map-final-position-metrics/docs/map-generators/images/start-quality-metrics.png)

Limits: local validation was on macOS; CI supplies other platform builds. Static metrics were not correlated with game outcomes, and no human playtest or generation-time comparison was performed.

CI report bundles: [Ubuntu 22.04](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/35002056131/artifacts/10410242128) and [Ubuntu 24.04](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/35002056131/artifacts/10410386354). The 22.04 `maze.json` contains schema 2, six normalized-factor spreads, and 12/24/48-step bands for all four players.

[Windows map-report bundle](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/actions/runs/35002056131/artifacts/10410860302): its same-seed `maze.json` matches Ubuntu 22.04 for canonical score/fairness, each player's exclusive catchment tiles, and each player's 12/24/48-step wheat stock. All seven CI jobs passed.
title: Report per-colony final-map position metrics
